entities.summary: Bill R. Newton is an American former basketball player. A power forward–center, he played two seasons in the American Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Indiana Pacers during the 1972–73 and 1973–74 seasons. Born in Rockville, Indiana, he attended Louisiana State University and played for coach Press Maravich.
